name: What is the difference between historic millwork restoration and general carpentry repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between historic millwork restoration and general carpentry repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Historic millwork restoration focuses on preserving original materials and craftsmanship, often requiring specialized techniques like dutchman repairs or epoxy consolidation, and matching period-specific profiles and finishes. General carpentry repair might involve more straightforward replacements with modern materials or techniques. A key distinction is the emphasis on maintaining historical authenticity and value in restoration, which often involves more time-intensive, artisan-level work compared to standard repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Historic millwork restoration preserves original materials and craftsmanship with specialized techniques, unlike general carpentry repair that may use modern methods.
